name: db
title: Drizzle + Postgres
description: Cached drizzle client (getDb) with pool size, statement_timeout, lock_timeout, idle_in_transaction_session_timeout and application_name read from env; shared timestamp columns; drizzle.config.ts (schema/*.ts); scripts/migrate.ts; a production migration guard (scripts/migrate-production.ts: needs --production-url, refuses DATABASE_URL, dry listing unless --yes); and a local Postgres docker-compose.yml. package.json scripts cannot ship; add them: { "db:start": "docker compose up -d", "db:generate": "drizzle-kit generate", "db:migrate": "bun run scripts/migrate.ts", "db:migrate:production": "bun run scripts/migrate-production.ts", "db:studio": "drizzle-kit studio" }. Then run db:start, db:generate and db:migrate.

files.content:
import { timestamp } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core"

/**
 * Shared audit columns. Spread into every table: `pgTable("x", { id: ..., ...timestamps })`.
 * `updatedAt` refreshes on every drizzle update, so callers never set it by hand.
 */
export const timestamps = {
  createdAt: timestamp("created_at").defaultNow().notNull(),
  updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at")
    .defaultNow()
    .$onUpdate(() => new Date())
    .notNull(),
}

# Local Postgres only. The app itself runs on the host (`bun dev`).
# DATABASE_URL in .env.local must match (set DB_PORT to move the host port): postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/app

services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    ports:
      - "${DB_PORT:-5432}:5432"
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
      POSTGRES_DB: app
    volumes:
      - pg_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres -d app"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

volumes:
  pg_data:
